description_en: Publishes a message to a device by using a custom topic. This operation also supports sending broadcast messages to online devices that have subscribed to a specified custom topic under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口通过自定义Topic向设备发布消息，支持向指定产品下订阅了指定自定义Topic的在线设备发送广播消息
kebab_example: aliyun iot pub --product-key a1Q5XoY0000 --topic-full-name /a1Q5XoY0000/device1/user/get --message-content eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBwdWIgYnJvYWRjYXN0In0= --region cn-hangzhou
name: Pub

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify the ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The correlation data in the request and response pattern when the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol is used. You can customize the data.

The party that accepts the message can process the request based on the correlation data.

You must transform the correlation data into binary data and perform Base64 encoding to generate a string
parameters.help_zh:
使用MQTT 5.0版本通信协议时，请求和响应模式中的相关数据，用户可自定义。

消息接收方可根据相关数据处理请求。

您需要将相关数据转换为二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成String类型数据
parameters.name: correlation_data

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device that receives the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要接收消息的设备所属产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the MQTT cloud gateway device.

<notice>
You need to specify this parameter only when you want to publish a message to a specified MQTT cloud gateway device.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
MQTT云网关设备的名称。

<notice>
仅当需要向指定MQTT云网关设备发布消息时，需要传入该参数。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The method of sending the message. Valid values:

0: At most once.
1: At least once. If a message with QoS=1 does not receive a PUBACK message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

For more information about communication messages, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定消息的发送方式。取值：

0：最多发送一次。
1：最少发送一次。如果QoS=1消息未接收到PUBACK消息，会在设备重连时，重新推送给设备。

如果不传入此参数，则使用默认值0。

通信消息的更多使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.name: qos

parameters.help_en:
The content type of the published message when the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol is used.

This parameter is typically used to store MIME type files, such as text file types: text and plain. For more details, refer to this topic
parameters.help_zh:
使用MQTT 5.0版本通信协议时，发布消息的内容类型。

典型应用于存放MIME类型文件，例如，文本文件类型：text、plain
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en:
The payload identity of the published message when the MQTT 5.0 communication protocol is used. Valid values:
0: The message is unspecified byte data.
1: The payload of the message is character data in UTF-8 encoding
parameters.help_zh:
使用MQTT 5.0版本通信协议时，发布消息的有效载荷标识，可取值：
0：消息是未确定的字节数据。
1：消息的有效载荷是UTF-8编码的字符数据
parameters.name: payload_format_indicator

parameters.help_en: The response topic in the request and response mode when the MQTT 5.communication protocol is used. This is the topic used for communication. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30540.html
parameters.help_zh: 使用MQTT 5.0版本通信协议时，请求和响应模式中的响应主题，即通信的Topic。更多消息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30540.html
parameters.name: response_topic

parameters.help_en:
The custom topic of the device that receives the message.

For <props="china"><ph>open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is the original custom topic of the device. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433806.html.
For <props="china"><ph>non-open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>non-MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic supports the following formats:

    - `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`: sends a message to a specified device under a specified ProductKey.
    - `/broadcast/${productKey}/${CustomField}`: sends a message to online devices that have subscribed to this topic under a specified ProductKey. `${productKey}` is the ProductKey of the specific product that receives the broadcast message. `${CustomField}` is a custom field.

<notice> 
The operation permission of the topic must be Subscribe or Publish and Subscribe.
Before you call this operation, the device must have subscribed to the topic and not canceled the subscription. Otherwise, the device cannot receive the published message.

</notice>

Methods to query custom topics:

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html operation to query the custom topics under a product.
On the Product Details page in the IoT Platform console, click the Topic Categories tab to query the custom topics under a product.
On the Device Details page in the IoT Platform console, click the Topic List tab to view the custom topics to which the device has subscribed
parameters.help_zh:
要接收消息的设备的自定义Topic。

对于<props="china"><ph>开源MQTT托管形态设备和</ph></props>MQTT云网关设备，自定义Topic为设备的原始自定义Topic。详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433806.html。
对于<props="china"><ph>非开源MQTT托管形态设备和</ph></props>非MQTT云网关设备，自定义Topic的格式支持为：

    - `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`：发送消息到指定ProductKey的指定设备。
    - `/broadcast/${productKey}/${自定义字段}`：发送消息到指定ProductKey下已订阅该Topic的在线设备。`${productKey}`是要接收广播消息的具体产品的ProductKey；`${自定义字段}`为您自定义的任意字段。

<notice> 
Topic的操作权限必须为订阅或发布和订阅。
调用该接口前，设备必须已订阅该Topic且未取消，否则无法接收本次发布的消息。

</notice>

查询自定义Topic方法：

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html接口，查询产品下的自定义Topic。
在物联网平台控制台产品详情页面的Topic类列表页签下，查询产品下的自定义Topic。
在物联网平台控制台设备详情页面的Topic列表页签下，查看设备已订阅的自定义Topic
parameters.name: topic_full_name

parameters.help_en: The body of the message to be sent. You must convert the original message into binary data and encode the binary data in Base64 to generate the message body
parameters.help_zh: 要发送的消息主体。您需要将消息原文转换成二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成消息主体
